title: Clear-Tape Head Displacement Bound
statement: Let $d$ be a configuration of a four-work-tape machine, let $b,e,w$ be finite words over its symbol alphabet, and let $j_0$ be one of its four tapes. Suppose $j_0$ is tape $1$ or tape $3$, with $b=w$ if $j_0=1$ and $e=w$ if $j_0=3$. Starting from the snapshot with phase `sweep`, zero offset, and buffer words $b,e$, after any $u\le 2|w|+2$ steps of the machine that clears tape $j_0$, every work-tape head lies within distance $|w|+1$ of its position in $d$.
hypotheses_covered: Universal bound for every work tape
